notes:
Patch 0.1.13

This is a full Windows build. Get it from the website Download button. The game will not quit itself to install this.

Held items
- Stones, tools, and other hand props stay visible on host and client. World pickup LOD groups were stripping the mesh after the hand shrink.

Chat
- Typing a Friends gamertag no longer leaks into move, hotkeys, or pause.
- Esc from Friends closes Friends and Chat.

World
- Tree stands are thinner and spaced farther apart.
- Trees and cardboard impostors draw much farther out.
- Leaves sit in the fog instead of on top of it.
- Village talk has no sexual lines.
- Under a roof or cave, rain stops on you and the outdoor rain sound muffles.

Storms and buildings
- Lightning can rarely hit a building. Base chance is extremely low (about 0.2% of bolts). Taller roofs weigh more.
- Lightning on wood starts a fire. Fire spreads to nearby wood and trees while dry.
- Rain puts structure fires out and stops spread.

Updates
- On the menu the game checks for a newer build. If the patch list has a direct zip link, it can download and apply after a short countdown you can cancel.
- Mega / website-only links open the Download page instead of quitting into PowerShell.

Still from 0.1.12
- Host and clients share time of day and day of year.
- Remote walk/run and rune sprites animate properly.
- Ride bug lift matches the host and sits higher.
- Hold INS for the server roster.
- Walking backward plays walk/run in reverse.
- Clear weather fog at about two thirds the old distance.
- Sealclash AI takes downs first when a Front is soft; pip economy is slower.
- Settings on the pause menu.

Website
- Teen 13+ advisory: Fantasy Violence, Mild Blood, Mild Drug Use.
